day 4

today was a losing day, but not mad about it. it was a good trade. today we was bullish, we had a 4hr RB in a 4hr gap. so i was bullish. when market open. i saw that we created a 5m rb. it was a good limit, however there was the 4hr RB CE and it was tied to 00:00 ko. so i wasn't trying to trade that and waited for 10am. when it was getting close to 10am. i saw that we created eq highs on nq. so i was bullish, however there was no entries for me to run to those eq high. there was a 1m rb ce into a 1m fvg but it was more probability to get stoped by and the go to tp. so i was waiting for a better entry, i saw that we formed a 15m gap so i wanted it to tap there and then go to eqhs, but it never got there and ran to eqh. so i now wanted shorts to 10am ko. a 5m rb formed, so i limit on the 5m, mostly cause we swept eqh on nq and then later es. it was edging my stop but then it displaced lower. this is where i messed up. i shouldve gone BE because the displacement was just trying to head bulish again. making longer wicks on the bottom. but i was confident we was going to go to 10am ko. my stop got filled.
